# Diffusive Quantum Storage

Finite-time, one-use quantum storage under unobserved nearest-neighbor Poisson SWAPs on a qubit path. No intervention occurs during storage. All physical spins are counted; endpoint complexity is unoptimized.

- Exact model, resources and half-diamond error: science/model.md
- Finite-size theorem, constants, floors and scaling: science/storage_theorem.md
- Favorable-origin channel identity and stopped-walk bounds: science/guarded_blocks.md
- Symmetric partial trace, Haar coding and subcode recovery: science/one_shot_coding.md
- Inherited late-time one-shot upper: science/late_time.md
- Mechanism, lifetime threshold and scope: science/interpretation.md
- Connected reading route: science/README.md
- Primary comparisons and attribution: references/RELATED_WORK.md
- Bibliography: references/references.bib
- Reproducible finite checks and their limits: verification/README.md

The guarded finite-time growing-payload code is the contribution. Symmetric-loss geometry, random coding, exact symmetry protection and classical mixing are inherited tools. Do not infer matching capacity scaling, efficient circuits, a quantum cutoff profile or generic-noise robustness from the achievable lower bound.

Learning route (single anchor: Watrous2018):
- learning/README.md: entry points
- learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md: verified source sections and notation translation
- learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly30project-defined targets (12background,18narrative)
- learning/WORKED_EXAMPLES.md: reference-entangled block, unconditional error and finite overhead
